notes.title: The Megatonk Update!
notes.content:
[h2]New Free Sport![/h2]

A whole new sport has been added to Wrestledunk! Megatonk is fast, fun and really different from all the other sports. It's got double jump, and bats! It's also my new favorite sport in the pack.

It comes complete with full 8 player local and online support, with 12 arenas to unlock!

[h2]New Arenas and other Updates![/h2]

- Volleyball has 2 new arenas to play on, with new moving nets!
- Added new outfits
- Improved consistency on moving platforms and other complex cases across all sports
- Improved networking performance and matchmaking consistency
- Fixed an issue where sometimes you could get kicked from your own room

Hope you like it!
-Matt

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38032996/a4f8ad96956c6674f2ecf39fb4540eeacafb30fc.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Notes for September 9
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed several issues with matchmaking and rooms, including and issue that would kick you from a room where you were the host.
[*] Fixed fencing landing from spawn sound playing multiple times under some network conditions
[*] Fixed several impact sounds not playing correctly under some rollback conditions
[/list]
Jumping over the net in Volleyball is [i]not[/i] a bug and I will never, ever fix it.

notes.title: Update Notes for August 27
notes.content:
- Fixed a rare issue that could cause all inputs to be delayed
- Fixed some reflect sounds playing many times in Wrestling
- Fixed some menu prompts when using keybaord controls
- Fixed some networking menu buttons always playing at full volume
- Fixed tutorial messages not showing up in some cases
- Updated rematch sound

notes.title: Wrestledunk Sports, out now!
notes.content:
Wrestledunk sports is out now! Try out the demo, which has Volleyball and Wrestling with a few arenas to play online free forever!
Get into a room cross-platform using room codes. Looking for other athletes to play against? Join the Wrestledunk Discord!

https://discord.com/invite/5x9TqcU

Keep an eye out for new full sports coming in future updates - follow @WrestledunkGame to stay up to date!

notes.title: Wrestledunk Sports Demo!
notes.content:
[h1]Try the Wrestledunk Sports demo now![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38032996/34dc336e707fa8f6960448d6eee9b29fca273fe0.png[/img]

Wrestling and Volleyball are unlocked and ready to play! Grab some friends, or go online and get your Wrestledunk on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38032996/3f8e3dfbf304a10251960c098dbd30aeff06fa47.png[/img]

All of the Wrestledunk sports are fast, fun, and tightly designed around being easy to pick up and super polished, without sacrificing the high skill ceiling. Best played with or against friends! If you're looking for people to play with, or against (and you're too powerful for the normal matchmaking), head over the [url=https://discord.gg/5x9TqcU]the Wrestledunk discord here[/url]!

See you in there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38032996/e10e6e7c2f4e9b3d2a057d628fde6aef41b1d8f2.png[/img]

notes.title: Wrestledunk Developers vs Chat: livestream showdown!
notes.content:
[i]These age old questions...
Streamer vs Chat
Developer vs Player
Which is better at games?[/i]


This one's easy actually - the developers will win by a lot. 

Come and watch us destroy contenders from chat in Volleyball and Wrestling! We'll be showing off the game, talking about it's design, and giving chat the business with some fancy moves. Think you can take the developers at their own sports? Get some practice in, and challenge us in this Devs vs Players livestream!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38032996/99bfccf0a90a7cd07e4ce1561da0cac3ceb9f5ff.png[/img]

notes.title: Chat with the Developers
